parameters.content:
## AI-assisted headline discovery
Local Gemma suggests one extra query per company.
Core four searches always run if AI is unavailable.
Headlines/links are copied from actual public search results.
Open Research and Signals → headlines or headline_markdown.
Unknown dates stay separate; job ads excluded from headline feed.
Usable excerpts still go to Agent 3. No HTTP Request nodes.

parameters.text:
=Suggest ONE additional short public-web search for EACH company to discover recent IT/cybersecurity headlines beyond generic searches.
Companies: {{ JSON.stringify($json.companies) }}
Window: {{ $json.window_start }} to {{ $json.window_end }}
Copy company names exactly. terms should be 3–10 search words/phrases covering a useful angle such as digital transformation partnerships, AI governance, OT security, identity programs, security vendors or leadership interviews.
Do not invent headlines, facts, source names, URLs, or specific company technology deployments.
Do not put the company name, URLs, site:, before:, after: or dates in terms; code adds company/date restrictions.
Return JSON with searches, an array of objects with company and terms. If unavailable return {"searches":[]}. JSON only.

parameters.jsCode: const p=$input.first().json;if(p.ai_search_planning?.additional_queries!==1)throw new Error('Local AI did not add its bounded query');if(p.statistics.queries_planned!==5)throw new Error('Expected five searches');const byId=new Map([...p.evidence_records,...p.review_queue].map(r=>[r.source_id,r]));for(const h of p.headlines){const r=byId.get(h.source_id);if(!r||h.headline!==r.title||h.source_url!==r.source_url)throw new Error('Headline or link is not copied from a search result');if(!h.publication_date||h.publication_date<p.research_window.start||h.publication_date>p.research_window.end)throw new Error('Headline date out of window');if(r.source_type==='job_ad')throw new Error('Job ad entered headline feed');}return [{json:{passed:true,statistics:p.statistics,planning:p.ai_search_planning,headline_statistics:p.headline_statistics,headlines:p.headlines,headline_markdown:p.headline_markdown}}];
